title: Computational modeling and photovoltaic performance evaluation of various ETL/HTL engineered CsCdI3-based perovskite solar cell architectures
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32679-32707
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05441A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ashraful Mujahid, Mohammad Yasin Hayat Khan, Md Mayen Uddin, Fahad Alhashmi Alamer, O. Alsalmi, Md. Rasheduzzaman, Md. Zahid Hasan
This study employs SCAPS-1D simulations to optimize CsCdI3-based perovskite solar cells, systematically evaluating 48 device architectures with varied transport layers, BMC optimization, and key parameters such as thickness, and band alignment.
